title: Nurturing Smoky Slovakian Tofu Bowl
description: A resinous, molten, adventurous Slovakian tofu bowl that blends cold water marination, smoke-hot searing and diabetic-friendly flavors.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: cut into 1 inch cubes after pressing

instructions: Press the tofu for 15 minutes to remove excess moisture, then cut into 1 inch cubes.
Whisk together cold water, liquid smoke, smoked paprika, garlic powder, and soy sauce to create a marinating liquid.
Submerge the tofu cubes in the liquid and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat and add the marinated tofu cubes, cooking until all sides are golden and crispy, about 8 minutes.
Sauté the cauliflower rice in a separate pan with a splash of water until tender, about 5 minutes.
Arrange the cooked cauliflower rice as the base in a serving bowl.
Top the rice with the crispy tofu, diced cucumber, and bell pepper.
Drizzle lemon juice over the bowl and sprinkle fresh dill.
Serve immediately to keep the tofu crunchy and the flavors vibrant.
Enjoy a spicy, smoky Slovakian tofu bowl that is diabetic-friendly and low-carb.
